description: Adobe Analytics data collection beacons, whose report suite IDs ride on the path after /b/ss/. Edge Network interact and collect are vendor/adobe-web-sdk.

params.name: report_suite
params.description: It is the report suite ID, or a comma-separated list of them, and it sits immediately after `/b/ss/` in the path.
params.fix_hint: Point the beacon at a report suite ID from the Adobe Analytics admin.

params.name: mid
params.description: It is the Experience Cloud ID that ties the hit to a visitor.

params.name: g
params.description: It is the page URL, up to 255 bytes. Adobe documents it as the Page URL dimension.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `g`. Longer URLs continue in `-g`.

params.name: pageName
params.description: It is the page name. `gn` is the documented shorthand.
params.fix_hint: Set `pageName` or `gn` to the page name you want in reports.

params.name: events
params.description: It is the comma-separated list of events on the page. `ev` is the documented shorthand.

params.name: products
params.description: It is the products variable. `pl` is the documented shorthand.
params.fix_hint: Send the products string Adobe documents for the Product dimension.

params.name: pe
params.description: It is the hit type for link tracking. Adobe documents `lnk_o`, `lnk_d`, `lnk_e`, and `tnt`.
params.fix_hint: Use `lnk_o` for a custom link, `lnk_d` for a download, `lnk_e` for an exit, or `tnt` for Analytics for Target.

params.name: AQB
params.description: Adobe documents `AQB` as the start of an image request query string.

params.name: AQE
params.description: Adobe documents `AQE` as the end of an image request, meaning the request was not truncated.
params.fix_hint: If you send `AQB=1`, end the query with `AQE=1` so Adobe knows the hit was complete.

params.name: cc
params.description: It is the currency code of the hit. Adobe documents `cc` as `currencyCode`.
params.fix_hint: Send the three-letter ISO 4217 code, such as `USD`.

params.name: referrer
params.description: It is the referring URL of the hit. Adobe documents it as the Referrer dimension.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute referring URL in `referrer`.

params.name: purchaseID
params.description: It is the purchase ID. Adobe documents it as the Purchase ID dimension.
params.fix_hint: Set `purchaseID` to a stable order id, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: vid
params.description: It is the visitor ID override. Adobe documents `vid` as `visitorID`.
params.fix_hint: Set `vid` to the visitor ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: v0
params.description: It is the tracking code. Adobe documents `v0` as `campaign`.
params.fix_hint: Set `v0` or `campaign` to the campaign tracking code, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: pageType
params.description: It is the page type. Adobe documents `gt` as the shorthand. Typical value is `errorPage`.
params.fix_hint: Set `pageType` or `gt` to the page type, such as `errorPage`.

params.name: server
params.description: It is the server dimension. Adobe documents `sv` as the shorthand.
params.fix_hint: Set `server` or `sv` to the server name, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: The beacon starts with `AQB` but has no `AQE`. Adobe documents `AQE` as the end marker, so a missing `AQE` means the request was truncated.
